cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Arms out like yours. Distance checked. That door's farther away: are we shrinking, or is the room growing? We need to move the sofa.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was stretching. Whichever gets us finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Limbered up, yes. Shrinking means call full-sized help. Growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

reason: Copied stretch becomes false measurement confidence; B practical demand leads A to force an actionable choice and apply it consistently.
